walkthrough.short: Put your {hand} hand on the wrist of the dancer ahead of you and walk forward, {places}.
walkthrough.long: All four put the {hand} hand on the wrist of the dancer ahead of you round the star, not in a pile in the middle. Keep your arm a little bent and walk forward round the center: {places}. {where}

walkthrough.short: Take {hand} hands with the dancer diagonally opposite, one hand each, and walk forward, {places}.
walkthrough.long: Reach across the star and take {hand} hands with the dancer diagonally opposite you, one hand each, the robins' pair held a little above the larks'. Walk forward round the center: {places}. {where}
